renderDetails.messageTitle: Message from Risk & Policy Spec Miner (teamwork_preview_spec_miner)

content:
Priyanshu,

**Context**: Milestone 1 (M1) — Specification Miner 2: Deep Risk & Policy Investigation (Requirement R2)
**Content**: I have completed the comprehensive investigation of all 8 risk and policy categories for the GTA Spider-Man kids YouTube niche with exact legal citations, statutory precedents, FTC enforcement data, YouTube YPP policies, Take-Two modding policies, and empirical channel analytics.

Key Artifacts Generated:
1. Full Risk & Policy Report: `C:\Users\renu5\.gemini\antigravity\brain\7e10fb73-4127-4bf9-bb71-c8115ab6b9b4\risk_policy_report.md`
2. Structured 5-Component Handoff: `C:\Users\renu5\.gemini\antigravity\brain\7e10fb73-4127-4bf9-bb71-c8115ab6b9b4\handoff.md`

Core Findings Summary:
- **Monetization Paradox**: Nemo (@nemo-gta) failed YPP due to automated "Inauthentic Content" and "Reused Content" flags triggered by templated metadata and non-commentary gameplay loops, representing a 75-85% estimated niche failure rate.
- **COPPA & FTC Enforcement**: Content is 100% child-directed under 16 C.F.R. § 312.2. Civil penalties reach $53,088/violation under the 2025/2026 inflation-adjusted FTC rules following the $170M Google settlement. Complying collapses RPM by 60-90% ($0.50-$1.98).
- **Copyright & Take-Two EULA**: 100% failure under all 4 Fair Use statutory factors (17 U.S.C. § 107) for ripped 3D meshes of Marvel/Sony IP, plus direct breach of Take-Two's PC Modding Policy prohibiting commercialization and third-party IP import.
- **Technical & Hardware Barrier**: Requires an $1,800-$3,200 local PC rig (RTX 4070+, 32GB RAM, Gen4 NVMe) with manual game engine patch tuning (gameconfig, HeapAdjuster) to prevent memory crashes.

**Action**: Please review the comprehensive report and handoff for integration into the master research synthesis and Milestone 2 roadmap.
